title: Reported Speech
summary: Report what someone said using backshifted tenses and changed pronouns.

theory.markdown:
Reported speech (indirect speech) is used to report what someone said.

When the reporting verb is in the past (said, told, asked), the tense shifts back:

say vs tell:
- She said she was tired. (no personal object after 'say')
- She told me she was tired. ('tell' needs a person after it)

Pronoun changes: I to he/she, we to they, my to his/her, you to I/he/she.

theory.title: Tense backshift in reported speech
rows: past simple: She said she worked there.
past continuous: He said he was leaving.
past perfect: She said she had gone there.
present perfect: I have seen it.
past perfect: He said he had seen it.
would: She said she would help.
could: He said he could swim.

items.source: They said they would call me.
He told me he had never been to London.
items.translation: Powiedzial mi, ze nigdy nie byl w Londynie.

exercises.instruction: Report what she said. She said: I am tired.
answers: She said she was tired.
She said that she was tired.

exercises.prompt: He said he ___ (will) call me later.
answers: would
exercises.hint: will becomes would in reported speech.

exercises.prompt: She said she ___ come to the party. (direct: I can't come)
exercises.explanation: can becomes could in reported speech.

exercises.sentence: She said me that she was happy.
answers: She told me that she was happy.
She said that she was happy.
exercises.explanation: Say does not take a personal object. Use tell me or say (that).

answers: He said he didn't know the answer.
He said that he didn't know the answer.

exercises.instruction: Change to reported speech. They said: We have finished the project.
exercises.source: They said: We have finished the project.
answers: They said they had finished the project.
They said that they had finished the project.

exercises.prompt: She told me she ___ (be) a doctor.
answers: was
exercises.hint: Present simple (am/is/are) -> past simple in reported speech.

exercises.prompt: Direct: 'I worked here last year.' Reported: He said he ___.
options: had worked there the previous year
exercises.explanation: Past simple -> past perfect. 'Last year' -> 'the previous year'.

exercises.sentence: He told that he was very busy.
answers: He said that he was very busy.
He told me that he was very busy.
exercises.explanation: 'Tell' always needs a person after it: told me/him/her. 'Say' does not.

answers: She said she would come the next day.
She said that she would come the next day.
She said she would come tomorrow.

exercises.instruction: Change to reported speech. He said: I can speak Spanish.
exercises.source: He said: I can speak Spanish.
answers: He said he could speak Spanish.
He said that he could speak Spanish.

exercises.prompt: She said she ___ (be) studying when I called.
answers: had been studying
exercises.hint: Past continuous -> past perfect continuous in reported speech.

exercises.prompt: Which is correct reported speech for: 'I live in London'?
options: She said she lives in London.
She said she lived in London.
She said she had lived in London.
She told she lived in London.
exercises.explanation: Present simple -> past simple in reported speech: 'she lived'.

exercises.source: Powiedzieli, ze nie moga przyjsc na przyjecie.
answers: They said they couldn't come to the party.
They said that they couldn't come to the party.
